== Possible matches (not added) ==
* Andy McClure's Birmingham Grand Slam report thanks "Matt Redd for winning the YJ Grand Slam", the Young Jedi event of the same weekend that Matt Reed ran the SWCCG event: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-31-birmingham-grand-slam-10-28-00d1410/ birmingham-grand-slam-10-28-00], DeckTech (Andy McClure, 31 October 2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261025142814/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-31-birmingham-grand-slam-10-28-00d1410/ Internet Archive]
* Throdo's 2009 Dragon Con results post says of the Saturday night sealed deck event, "Actually I know one was named Matt Reed"; no place is given and nothing ties him to Huntsville: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=30380 RESULTS!], Players Committee forum (Throdo, 8 September 2009). Snapshot: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t30380.html swccg.com]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027130314/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t30380.html Internet Archive]
* Jody Rodd's report thanks "Jim Coulson and Matt Reed" as the Birmingham Grand Slam's tournament directors; Jim Coulson may be [[Jim Colson]], but the spelling differs, so only Matthew Reed's credit was added: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-30-birmingham-grand-slam-10-28-00d1405/ birmingham-grand-slam-10-28-00], DeckTech (Jody Rodd, 30 October 2000). == "FL" answered (13 November 2026) ==
"FL" on Squadron slots means '''Flight Leader''': a key volunteer who worked more directly with Decipher ("basically a volunteer that helped decipher coordinate events", Ming Huo; "key volunteers that would be more involved directly with decipher", Scott Lingrell; Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, 9 October 2026). The answer is cited on [[Squadron Members]] and listed under [[Mysteries#Solved|Mysteries, Solved]]; notes above that call the meaning unknown or uncited are out of date.
